response.sql: WITH scan_site_join AS (SELECT s.gbsize, s.spanmin, z.riskeval FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites z ON s.zoneref = z.zoneregistry), group_rates AS (SELECT riskeval, SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin) as group_rate FROM scan_site_join GROUP BY riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(group_rate) as bench_rate FROM group_rates), above_benchmark AS (SELECT gr.group_rate, b.bench_rate FROM group_rates gr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gr.group_rate > b.bench_rate) SELECT AVG(group_rate) as avg_of_above_rates, AVG(group_rate - bench_rate) as avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark
